claims.text: Tesla is investing in compute infrastructure and data centers to support its artificial intelligence initiatives.

quotes.text: we currently expect our capital expenditures to be in excess of $20 billion in 2026, driven by our AI initiatives, including investments in compute infrastructure and data centers

claims.text: Alphabet offers AI-optimized infrastructure and AI accelerator options, including GPUs and custom Tensor Processing Units (TPUs), to its cloud customers.

quotes.text: Our technical infrastructure allows us to use and offer our customers a range of AI accelerator options, including specialized Graphics Processing Units (GPUs) and our own custom-built Tensor Processing Units (TPUs)

claims.text: SanDisk's product portfolio includes high-performance flash storage solutions specifically designed for AI workloads in data centers.

quotes.text: our broad and ever-expanding portfolio delivers powerful flash storage solutions for artificial intelligence (“AI”) workloads in datacenters, edge devices, and consumer applications.

claims.text: NVIDIA provides data center-scale AI infrastructure and platforms, including GPUs and networking systems, used by cloud service providers and enterprises.

quotes.text: All major cloud service providers, or CSPs, AI model makers, and enterprises use our data center-scale infrastructure and computing platforms to accelerate the services and offerings they deliver

claims.text: Meta is significantly increasing infrastructure investments, including servers, data centers, and network infrastructure, to support its AI initiatives.

quotes.text: we have significantly increased our infrastructure investments in connection with our AI initiatives, including third-party cloud capacity arrangements and investments in servers, data centers

claims.text: Microsoft is investing in data center infrastructure and cloud services to support global demand for AI workloads.

quotes.text: We have made and are continuing to make significant capital and operational investments to develop, train, deploy, and support AI models and related cloud-based services, including building and expanding datacenters

claims.text: Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides cloud-based compute, storage, and AI and machine learning infrastructure to enterprises and developers.

quotes.text: through AWS, which offers a broad set of on-demand technology services, including compute, storage, database, analytics, artificial intelligence and machine learning, and other services.

claims.text: Tesla generates revenue from subscriptions for FSD (Supervised) and premium connectivity.

quotes.text: Customers may purchase subscriptions, including FSD (Supervised) and premium connectivity, after taking delivery of their vehicles.

claims.text: Alphabet generates revenue from online advertising and consumer subscriptions for services like YouTube TV, YouTube Music, and Google One.

quotes.text: Google Services generates revenues primarily from advertising; fees received for consumer subscription-based products such as YouTube TV, YouTube Music and Premium, and NFL Sunday Ticket, as well as Google One

claims.text: Meta generates revenue primarily from selling advertising placements on its platforms.

quotes.text: Currently, we generate substantially all of our revenue from selling advertising placements on our family of apps to marketers

claims.text: Apple generates revenue from advertising and from App Store commissions on digital content and services.

quotes.text: Services net sales increased during the third quarter and first nine months of 2026 compared to the same periods in 2025 primarily due to higher net sales from advertising and cloud services.
